actions.binance_get_price.description: Get the latest trade price of one Binance spot trading pair.
actions.binance_get_price.props.symbol.d: The trading pair: base asset followed by quote asset, for example BTCUSDT or ETHBTC. Spaces and '/' are removed and letters are upper-cased, so 'btc/usdt' also works. Use List Trading Pairs to find a symbol.
actions.fetch_crypto_pair_price.descript: Fetch the current price of a pair (e.g. BTC/USDT)
actions.fetch_crypto_pair_price.props.fi: The currency to fetch the price for (e.g. 'BTC' in 'BTC/USDT')
actions.fetch_crypto_pair_price.props.se: The currency to fetch the price in (e.g. 'USDT' in 'BTC/USDT')
actions.get_24h_ticker.description: Get 24-hour price change, high, low, volume and best bid/ask for a Binance spot trading pair.
actions.get_24h_ticker.props.symbol.desc: The trading pair: base asset followed by quote asset, for example BTCUSDT or ETHBTC. Spaces and '/' are removed and letters are upper-cased, so 'btc/usdt' also works. Use List Trading Pairs to find a symbol.
actions.get_24h_ticker.props.type.descri: Full (default) adds price change and percent, weighted average price, previous close, last quantity and best bid/ask. Mini returns only open, high, low and last price, volumes and trade count.
actions.get_average_price.description: Get Binance's current average price of a spot trading pair over its short averaging window (5 minutes).
actions.get_average_price.props.symbol.d: The trading pair: base asset followed by quote asset, for example BTCUSDT or ETHBTC. Spaces and '/' are removed and letters are upper-cased, so 'btc/usdt' also works. Use List Trading Pairs to find a symbol.
actions.get_candles.description: Get open, high, low, close and volume candles of a Binance spot trading pair at a chosen interval.
actions.get_candles.props.end_time.descr: Optional. Return candles that open at or before this time (UTC). Must not be earlier than the start time.
actions.get_candles.props.interval.descr: Length of each candle. 1m is one minute and 1M is one month.
actions.get_candles.props.limit.descript: How many candles to return, 1 to 1000. Defaults to 100.
actions.get_candles.props.start_time.des: Optional. Return candles that open at or after this time (UTC), for example 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z. Leave empty to get the most recent candles.
actions.get_candles.props.symbol.descrip: The trading pair: base asset followed by quote asset, for example BTCUSDT or ETHBTC. Spaces and '/' are removed and letters are upper-cased, so 'btc/usdt' also works. Use List Trading Pairs to find a symbol.
actions.get_candles.props.time_zone.desc: Optional. Offset from UTC used to align daily and longer candles, such as 8, -5 or 05:45 (from -12:00 to +14:00). Start and end times are always read as UTC. Defaults to UTC.
actions.get_multiple_prices.description: Get the latest trade prices of up to 100 Binance spot trading pairs in one call.
actions.get_multiple_prices.props.symbol: Trading pairs to price, for example BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT (base asset followed by quote asset). Up to 100. Spaces and '/' are removed, letters are upper-cased and duplicates are dropped. A comma-separated list in one item also works.
actions.get_order_book.description: Get the current best bids and asks (order book depth) of a Binance spot trading pair.
actions.get_order_book.props.limit.descr: Price levels to return on each side, 1 to 5000. Defaults to 20. Binance rate-limit weight: 5 up to 100 levels, 25 up to 500, 50 up to 1000, 250 above that.
actions.get_order_book.props.symbol.desc: The trading pair: base asset followed by quote asset, for example BTCUSDT or ETHBTC. Spaces and '/' are removed and letters are upper-cased, so 'btc/usdt' also works. Use List Trading Pairs to find a symbol.
actions.get_recent_trades.description: Get the most recent trades of a Binance spot trading pair.
actions.get_recent_trades.props.limit.de: How many of the most recent trades to return, 1 to 1000. Defaults to 50.
actions.get_recent_trades.props.symbol.d: The trading pair: base asset followed by quote asset, for example BTCUSDT or ETHBTC. Spaces and '/' are removed and letters are upper-cased, so 'btc/usdt' also works. Use List Trading Pairs to find a symbol.
actions.get_rolling_window_ticker.descri: Get price change, high, low and volume for a Binance spot trading pair over the last 1 minute to 7 days.
The trading pair: base asset followed by quote asset, for example BTCUSDT or ETHBTC. Spaces and '/' are removed and letters are upper-cased, so 'btc/usdt' also works. Use List Trading Pairs to find a symbol.
How far back the window reaches: a number and a unit, 1m to 59m (minutes), 1h to 23h (hours) or 1d to 7d (days), for example 15m, 4h or 7d. Units cannot be combined. Defaults to 1h.
actions.get_trading_pair_rules.descripti: Get the trading rules of a Binance spot pair: status, tick size, quantity step, minimum and maximum order size and value.
actions.get_trading_pair_rules.props.sym: The trading pair: base asset followed by quote asset, for example BTCUSDT or ETHBTC. Spaces and '/' are removed and letters are upper-cased, so 'btc/usdt' also works. Use List Trading Pairs to find a symbol.
actions.list_trading_pairs.description: List the Binance pairs open for spot trading right now (status TRADING and spot trading allowed), optionally filtered by base or quote asset.
actions.list_trading_pairs.props.base_as: Optional. Only pairs that trade this asset, for example BTC or ETH. Not case-sensitive.
actions.list_trading_pairs.props.limit.d: Most pairs to return, 1 to 1500. Defaults to 100. The output also says how many pairs matched in total.
actions.list_trading_pairs.props.quote_a: Optional. Only pairs priced in this asset, for example USDT, BTC or EUR. Not case-sensitive.
description: Get public Binance spot market data: prices, 24h statistics, order book, recent trades, candles and trading pairs. No API key needed.
